title: Finite-free compact-support coefficient comparison and composition
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R,S$, uniformizers $\pi,v$, and ramification index $e$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $n\ge1$ put $A_n=R/\pi^n$ and $B_n=S/\pi^nS=S/v^{en}$, a finite free $A_n$-algebra [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work with ordinary constant-coefficient module sheaves on fixed small pro-etale skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $C=A_n,B_n$ use the full subcategory $D^b_{ctf}(W,C)$ of bounded constructible complexes of $C_W$-modules having finite Tor amplitude: there exist integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring with any degree-zero $C_W$-module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $T_{W,n}=-\otimes_{A_n}^LB_n$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Fix compactifications for $f,g,gf$, and let $F_{h,C}=Rh_{!,C}$ be the compact-support functors defined by $Rp_*j_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Use the bounded constructible etale-origin realization of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. Let $\gamma_{g,f,C}:F_{g,C}F_{f,C}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{gf,C}$ be their canonical compact-support composition isomorphisms [thm-sf-comp-composition]. For $h=f,g,gf$, let $\alpha_{h,n}:T_{\operatorname{target}(h),n}F_{h,A_n}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{h,B_n}T_{\operatorname{source}(h),n}$ be the canonical finite-free comparison. On bounded constructible etale-origin witnesses it is obtained by composing the open-extension tensor comparison of [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor] and the proper direct-image projection comparison of [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]; its finite constructible pro-etale realization is the transported map under [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] and [lem-sf-comparison-open-tensor-coherence]. After forgetting $B_n$-coefficients its map in a finite free basis is finite-sum distributivity. Then, for every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$, the following equality of specified maps $T_{Z,n}F_{g,A_n}F_{f,A_n}K\to F_{gf,B_n}T_{X,n}K$ holds:
$$\gamma_{g,f,B_n,T_{X,n}K}\circ F_{g,B_n}(\alpha_{f,n,K})\circ\alpha_{g,n,F_{f,A_n}K}
=\alpha_{gf,n,K}\circ T_{Z,n}(\gamma_{g,f,A_n,K}).$$
For a normalized derived $A_n$-coefficient system $K_\bullet$ whose levels lie in these finite-Tor constructible categories, the same equation is an equality of the specified maps in the simultaneous derived semilinear-section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Here normalized means that every transition-adjoint map $K_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to K_n$ for $m\ge n$ is an isomorphism. The maps use the strict quotient transitions and one fixed $R$-basis of $S$ reduced at every $n$; the assertion is about these coherent constructions before total limit, not equality inferred solely from equality at each evaluation.

proof.text: The finite-level equation is exactly the reviewed finite-free compact-support composition lemma [lem-pur-finite-free-compact-composition]. Its coefficient map $c_{h,M}$ is the present $\alpha_{h,n,M}$: both are the counit-transpose proper projection map followed by the canonical open-extension balancing map, and the finite-free basis identification is the same in both constructions. The cited lemma states the displayed composition equation for every bounded constructible finite-Tor $M$, on the ordinary etale categories and under the canonical proper/open pro-etale comparisons. Substituting $S=T_{-,n}$, $M=K$, and its $\alpha_R=\gamma_{g,f,R}$ gives the finite-level assertion.

proof.text:
Regard $B_\bullet=(B_n)_n$, with its quotient transitions, as a strict $A_\bullet$-module system on every scheme $W$. It is normalized: for $m\ge n$, $B_m$ is free over $A_m$ on the reduction of the fixed $R$-basis of $S$, so $B_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n=B_m\otimes_{A_m}A_n=S/\pi^nS=B_n$. Its levels are constant sheaves of finite free $A_n$-modules, hence constructible of Tor amplitude $[0,0]$; thus $B_\bullet\in\mathscr N_W$ in the sense of [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence], and $h^*B_\bullet=B_\bullet$ for every $h$. The realization [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization] supplies the strict-system functors $\mathcal F_h$ with their quotient transitions, and [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] (applied to both ring systems $A_\bullet$ and $B_\bullet$) supplies simultaneous models of pullback, derived direct image, open extension, coefficient extension, tensor and their units and counits.

Restriction of scalars. Let $\operatorname{Res}$ be restriction of scalars from strict $B_\bullet$-systems to strict $A_\bullet$-systems and $T=B_\bullet\otimes_{A_\bullet}-$ its left adjoint. Since each $B_n$ is free over $A_n$, $T$ is exact levelwise and computes $-\otimes^L_{A_\bullet}B_\bullet$; $\operatorname{Res}$ is exact, and as the right adjoint of an exact functor it carries K-injective complexes to K-injective complexes. On module sheaves, $u^{-1}$, $u_*$ and $j_!$ commute with $\operatorname{Res}$ on the nose (the ring sheaves are constant, $u^{-1}(B_n)_W=(B_n)_{W'}$), and the sheaf-level adjunction units and counits are the same underlying maps. Computing $Ru_{*,B}$ on a K-injective $B_\bullet$-resolution therefore gives $\operatorname{Res}\,Ru_{*,B}=Ru_{*,A}\operatorname{Res}$, compatibly with units, counits and the direct-image compositors; hence $\operatorname{Res}\,\mathcal F_{h,B}=\mathcal F_h\operatorname{Res}$ and $\operatorname{Res}(\gamma_{g,f,B})=\alpha_{g,f,\operatorname{Res}(-)}$, since the compositor of [thm-sf-comp-composition] is built only from these maps.

Identification of the coefficient map. Let $\widetilde\alpha_h:T\mathcal F_hK_\bullet\to\mathcal F_{h,B}TK_\bullet$ be the specified system coefficient map, formed in the models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] exactly as $c_h$ in [lem-pur-finite-free-compact-composition]: the $p_B^*\dashv Rp_{*,B}$ transpose of $T(\varepsilon_{p,A})$, then the open balancing $Tj_!\cong j_!T$. By the unit compatibility just recorded, $\operatorname{Res}$ of a $B$-transpose is the $A$-transpose of the restricted map, so under $\operatorname{Res}TP=P\otimes^LB_\bullet$, $\operatorname{Res}(\widetilde\alpha_h)$ is the transpose of $(\varepsilon_{p}\otimes1)\mu_p$ followed by the open tensor comparison, i.e. $\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{h,K_\bullet,B_\bullet}$ of [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence]. This is an identity of the constructed system maps, not an inference from evaluations; its level-$n$ evaluation is $\alpha_{h,n}$ by Step 1.

proof.text:
Apply the strict-system identity of [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence] with $M=K_\bullet\in\mathscr N_X$ and $N=B_\bullet\in\mathscr N_Z$ (Step 2). Its left side is $\alpha_{g,f,K\otimes^LB}\,\mathcal F_g(\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{f,K,B})\,\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{g,\mathcal F_fK,B}$ and its right side is $\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{gf,K,B}(\alpha_{g,f,K}\otimes1)$, an equality in $D(\mathscr S_Z)$ before total inverse limit. By Step 2 these are $\operatorname{Res}$ of the two sides $\phi=\widetilde\gamma_{g,f,B}\,\mathcal F_{g,B}(\widetilde\alpha_f)\,\widetilde\alpha_g$ and $\psi=\widetilde\alpha_{gf}\,T(\widetilde\gamma_{g,f,A})$ of the item's equation, so $\operatorname{Res}\phi=\operatorname{Res}\psi$.

The item asks for $\phi=\psi$ as maps of $B_\bullet$-systems, and $\operatorname{Res}$ need not be faithful when $e>1$ (already for $n=1$, $e=2$, $B_1=A_1[v]/v^2$). Use instead that $\phi,\psi$ have source $TX$ with $X=\mathcal F_g\mathcal F_fK_\bullet$. The exact adjunction $T\dashv\operatorname{Res}$ of Step 2 passes to derived categories of systems, and a map $\chi:TX\to Y$ is determined by its transpose $\operatorname{Res}(\chi)\circ\eta_X$, with $\eta_X:X\to\operatorname{Res}TX$ the unit. Since $\operatorname{Res}\phi=\operatorname{Res}\psi$, the transposes agree, so $\phi=\psi$ in the derived category of $B_\bullet$-systems, before total limit. Under the equivalence of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] this is the asserted equality of the specified maps in the simultaneous section models. It is not inferred from equality of the level evaluations.

proof.text: Compactifications. The realization [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization] is formed from an arbitrary fixed compactification of each morphism, and the composition comparison of [thm-sf-comp-composition] is independent of compactification choices. So Steps 2 and 3 can be run directly with the compactifications of $f,g,gf$ fixed in the statement, and then the system maps are the specified $\widetilde\alpha_h$ and $\widetilde\gamma_{g,f,C}$. The strict-system compactification lemma [lem-pur-system-compactification-pf-substitution] shows further that the projection maps, and hence the $\widetilde\alpha_h$, are intertwined by the refinement comparisons $\theta_u$, and that these satisfy the identity and cocycle laws before evaluation. So the specified system maps do not depend on the auxiliary choice beyond the canonical $\theta$. Evaluating the equality of Step 3 at level $n$ gives the finite equation of Step 1 again, with the same maps.
